files.privacy/README.txt:
Data-subject enquiries, open.

enquiries.txt holds one line per open enquiry.
policy.txt defines the three bands enquiries are sorted into.
files.privacy/policy.txt:
Retention policy

Enquiries are banded by the number of days they have been open.
Band A: fewer days than retention.band_low.
Band B: from retention.band_low up to, but not including, retention.band_high.
Band C: retention.band_high days or more.
The two values are kept in the records configuration.
